children: A global aluminium producer has offered Japanese buyers a premium of $325 per metric ton for primary metal shipments in the October-December quarter, down 18% from the current quarter, two sources involved in the quarterly pricing talks said on Wednesday.
Japan is a major importer of the light metal and the premiums for primary metal shipments it agrees to pay each quarter over the London Metal Exchange cash price
Another global producer made an initial offer of a premium of $310 per ton last week, down 22% from the current quarter.
